s: April 24, 2020 - As much as we should respect those who’ve reached great heights, be it in media, business or sports, they cannot and should not do the irresponsible thing by lumping all humans into one single conscious collective. They don’t know us and they can’t possibly know what we’re capable of. It costs them nothing in making big motivational claims, but it can cost us dearly by blindly believing. Most of us buy into it because we really want to believe in the fantasy of “success” and “greatness” they’re selling us.
